text:
**What actually pulls you**

Under everything else, there's an engine. Sort these honestly — the honest order tells me what to feed and what to starve.

prompt: Sort these — what actually pulls you?
hint: Several of these will be true at once — the ranking is the point. Whatever sits on top is what I lean on.
choices: Breaking masculinity — the charge of failing at being a real man
Being pushed past my resistance — manipulated, forced, taken further than I'd go alone
Being degraded and made lesser — humiliation, embarrassment, the heat of being brought down
Getting off on my own transformation — aroused by watching myself become feminine
Structure, service, and someone's approval — obedience, rules, the comfort of submitting
The physical feel of change — fabrics, grooming, the senses of becoming
Escaping into the fantasy — sinking deep enough to lose ordinary self-awareness
Femininity already feels like me — living it and being seen as the girl I am inside
Having my mind rewritten — thoughts, self-talk, name, sense of self altered or overwritten
Relief from masculine pressure — a break from the expectations of performing manhood
Being seen feminine — mirrors, photos, others recognizing me as a girl
Turning my partner on — aroused by what my feminization does to them
